TALKING ABOUT U (Part 1) 

Okay, let me talk about this in a thread 🧵

Out of all the characters—and saying this with no bias—the one I personally found the most interesting is U. There’s this strong feeling that there’s still so much about his background that hasn’t been shown yet, and it feels intentional—like the story is saving it for the series to slowly reveal. That mystery alone already pulled me in.

We still have 3 days before the first episode airs, so I’m just going to drop some thoughts from the special episode.

Let’s talk about U (ahhh 😭 I really feel sorry for “Yu”—RIP to that name, I already loved it 😭).

U has been living his entire life as a scammer. He’s been a con artist from a very young age all the way into adulthood. And honestly? That alone already tells you how deep his character goes.

Being a scammer since you were young until the present is no joke. If he hadn’t been arrested even once, then yes—he’s a professional in his own league. That kind of consistency doesn’t happen by accident.

Every scammer in the story has their own “specialty.”
Tim is the type who plans everything with high accuracy—clean execution, near 100% success. That’s his strength.

But U is different.

U became a scammer because of financial problems, and it’s something that followed him throughout his life. Scamming wasn’t just a choice—it slowly became a necessity. When you do something from childhood until adulthood, repeating it over and over, it stops feeling wrong or unusual. It becomes normal. It becomes routine. It becomes something you feel you must do just to survive.

And that’s what makes U so interesting to me.
It feels like there’s still more pain, more history, and more reasons behind him that we haven’t seen yet—and I’m really looking forward to how the series will unfold that part of his story.

#MyRomanceScammer 
#OhmPoon #โอห์มปูน 
#OhmThitiwat
